en: A sunny forest clearing where heroes practise. The goblins did not get the memo.
Survive 5 waves of goblins. Every wave is bigger and tougher.
Hold interact on Moonleaf plants to collect 10 while goblins harass you.
Thin out the goblins to lure the Ogre. Then face it alone for an Ogre Tusk.
Nothing stored yet. Go earn something!
Woven leaves that harden like bark.
Hits like an Ogre. Leaves you as open as one.
Nothing crafted for this slot yet. Visit the Forge.
Hums softly. Drinks a little of your life to do it.
Rank %d!  +%d skill points (spend them at the Skill Shrine)
Chops wood. Chops goblins. Not picky.
Warm as noon. Tough as a vow.
Rare golden herbs grow among angrier goblins. Needs Herbalism 3 to harvest.
Tastes like a wet forest. Works like a miracle.
Fermented in a boot. You'll fight like it
Earn 3 skill points every Rank. Each spends on +1 level in any track.
Challenge: enemy HP +%d%%, damage taken +%d%%. Rewards x%.1f on victory.
Hits hard and moves fast, with a quick dodge. Fragile: a few mistakes and it's over.
A walking wall: lots of HP and armor. Slow on foot, slow to dodge, and hits softer.
Fights from a distance with magic bolts. Low HP: keep enemies away, blink out of trouble.
Choose your hero: click one or browse the cards
Each kill: +%d%% damage for %ds, stacking up to %d times.
+40% damage for 6 s but you take +20% damage.
Kills heal 5% max HP for 6 s. Does nothing if you aren't killing.
Rushes forward with strong knockback. Unlike a dodge you can still be hit.
Wide fan that stacks Poison. Weak on impact and strong over time.
Chills everything around you. Short range for a caster.
Heals 25% max HP over 4 s. Uses a key and a lot of mana.
+30% move speed for 5 s. Adds no damage or defense.
Restores 30 stamina by trading mana for more attacks and dodges.
Whirlwind that Burns. Costs more and hits softer.
Huge hit that breaks guards. A boss's hit during the long wind-up cancels it.
Quick 3-hit combo that stacks Chill. Low damage per hit.
Ground slam that Chills everything nearby.
Fire pulses around you for 5 s. Low damage so you must stay in the fight.
3 bolts in a row that can Freeze one target. Costs more and hits softer.
One big bolt that Burns. The long wind-up slows you and can leave you exposed.
Your basic attack deals Fire for 10 s. Uses a key that could hold an attack.
Fast single stab. Short reach so you must stand close.
Dashes forward and hits what it passes.
Spins and hits all around you.
Only when that skill is equipped
Pick a key and then a skill for it. Choices apply from your next mission.
Shared skills (at most 1 on your keys)
Free with the weapon. Elemental weapons add their own skills.
Bottled sunlight and moon-dew. Tingles all the way down.
Snow biome. Foes melt fast to Fire, shrug off Ice and never freeze. Drops Frost Shards.
Desert biome. Mummies crack under Ice, resist Fire and barely feel Poison. Drops Burial Wraps.
Hits harder. Your own heart beats slower.
Hard to kill. Hard to enjoy, too.
Cures %s and holds it off for %ds
Burns all the way down. That's the point.
Click to pick up and place. Right click: one at a time or half a stack.
Holding: %s x%d. Click a slot to place or a potion in camp to put it back.
Craft potions at the Forge to fill your Inventory.
Thin out the horde until the old yeti comes down the pass. Mind the icicles. Alone.
Still smells of yeti. Warm, heavy and slightly judgemental.
Thin out the horde until the old king wakes. He hides in his sarcophagus when hurt: smash his jars.
A king's strength, and maybe his curse. Probably fine.
Leave? Press again (you keep what you collected)
Forged with Sunbloom. Burns the cold out of anything, and runs a little hot on you.
Frost Shards in the edge. Bites the desert dead, and numbs the hand holding it.
A sliver of summer. Melts what the snow keeps, at the cost of a little of you.
Never stops being cold. The mummies hate it. So do your fingers.
No discovered recipes here. New materials from missions reveal new recipes.
Fits any head if you stuff it with enough goblin ear.
Built to hold up an Ogre. Holds up you with room to spare.
The toes were somebody else's idea of armor.
Three tusks and a lot of rope. Heavy on the arm, heavier on whoever hits it.
A sliver of Ogre, sharpened. Quick, mean and no use for parrying.
The horns are real. The yeti has stopped asking for them back.
Warm enough for a blizzard, tight enough to slow your swing.
Nothing gets through them. Not even a sense of the ground.
A frozen slab on a pole. Slow to rise, and shields do not survive it landing.
It remembers being worn. It would like to be worn by someone more important.
Burial linen stitched with gold. Stops blades. Smells like a very long nap.
Tightens when you cast. Loosens when you bleed. Nobody asked it to.
Walked out of a sealed tomb once already. They know the way.
Still giving orders. Pays you in power, and collects in blood.
Do not ask how it was bottled. Do not smell it first.
Your thoughts go very clear, and your teeth go very cold.
One sip of an old grudge. It is not yours, but you may borrow it.
Want to play the tutorial? It teaches moving, fighting, dodging, skills and gathering, then explains the camp. Practice only: nothing is saved, spent or lost.
New here? Read the Field Guide beside the Mission Board.
Leave? Press again to return to camp
You can't die in this tutorial. Take your time.
Aim with the mouse and hold [%s] to attack the goblin.
Every attack winds up, then commits. Attacks and dodges use stamina, the green bar.
Press [%s] to roll out of the ring before the disc fills it.  Dodged %d of %d
A ring on the ground means an attack is coming, and you can't be hit while rolling. Bosses warn you the same way.
Not quite. Roll just before the disc fills the ring.
Press one of [%s] to use a skill.
Keys 1 and 2 come from your hero, 3 and 4 from your weapon. Each box shows its cost in mana or stamina.
Walk to the plant and hold [%s] until it's picked.
Materials are what you craft gear from at the Forge.
Last lesson: put it all together and beat these goblins!
Watch them lean back before they swing, then roll or step away. Kills drop XP gems: walk near them to collect.
Back in camp, walk up to a station and press the key shown above it.
Mission Board: choose a map and objective and start a run. Read a boss's scouting report before you go.
Forge: craft weapons, armor and potions. New recipes appear as you find their materials.
Gear Rack: equip what you've crafted and fill your Inventory with potions. Your weapon sets skills 3 and 4.
Skill Shrine: spend skill points to level up, buy hero talents and choose your skills.
Other heroes: walk up to one to see their card and switch.
A wide brim of petals that never quite stop smoldering.
Knotted from stems. Warm against the ribs.
Your footprints dry out the grass.
Your breath fogs even at noon.
Stiff as a frozen washing line.
The cold starts at the toes. On purpose.
Spun from thawed shards. It refuses to stay thawed.
Whoever wore it last isn't complaining.
Still smells of the embalmer's jars.
Soles soaked in what kept the dead fresh.
Burial linen, steeped until it bites back.
A seed of noon on a string. Mind your fingers.
Waves keep coming, bigger and tougher, until you fall. You keep everything you collect.
The bosses you've unlocked, one after another, each on its own map and tougher than the last. HP, Run Level and potions carry over, and each kill gives back 30% of your HP. Bring potions.
Travel all three maps: 4 survival stages, then the boss, then on to the next. Beat all 3 to win. HP, Run Level and potions carry over, and the run saves at the start of every stage.
How far can you get next time?
It keeps its hero and difficulty. Abandoning keeps what you collected, but it isn't a win.
Save and leave? Press again (this stage restarts)
The cart took you home. You keep what you collected.

A giant boar with a back full of thorns roams Whisperwood. Track it from zone to zone (the HUD says where it was last seen), and finish it before it gets away. Badly hurt, it limps off to rest somewhere else: follow it. Zone goals are optional side tasks.

Whisperwood is full of sites: goblin camps, herb patches, puffcap rings, tusker wallows, hunters' caches, old watchtowers and standing stones, different every time. Clear any 8 to win (rewards x1.5); the farther from camp, the tougher. The compass points to the nearest. The cart at base camp takes you home early with what you collected, but that isn't a win.
A huge old forest under the mountains: a river, a high ridge, ruins and dark woods, joined by narrow passes, and something new behind every tree.
A desert oasis ringed by cliffs: sand round a great stone plateau, the Crown, with a lagoon to the west and a ruin beyond the northern pond. Mummified goblins hold it now.

Sites fill the basin: on the sand, up on the Crown and on its summit, different every time. Clear any 8 to win (rewards x1.5); the farther from camp, the tougher. The cart at base camp takes you home early with what you collected, but that isn't a win.

A frozen mountain maze: snowfields carved out of the rock, joined by narrow passes, dark tunnels and a crystal cavern, with a high shelf of peaks reached only through the ice caves. Frost goblins rule it.

Sites hide all through the peaks: in the snowfields, up on the high shelf and in the crystal cavern, different every time. Clear any 8 to win (rewards x1.5); the farther from camp, the tougher. The tunnels are the only way between some areas. The cart at base camp takes you home early with what you collected, but that isn't a win.
Short roguelike missions on Training Grounds, Frost Pass and Sunscar Dunes: hordes, gathering, bosses and the endless and Classic modes.
Big maps to explore: Whisperwood, Stonecrown Basin and Frostvein Peaks. Clear sites, hunt monsters, head home by cart.
